changes.evidence: Bucky breaks from HYDRA at the end of The Winter Soldier: he remembers Steve, pulls him from the Potomac, walks off, and attacks the HYDRA scientists at the bank vault. He is already off-grid in Ant-Man. Wakanda gives him asylum and puts him back in cryo-sleep in the Civil War mid-credits scene, not in Black Panther. The twin T:winter-soldier already has Independent at The Winter Soldier.
He leaves HYDRA in Captain America: The Winter Soldier (see the G1 entry). In Civil War he goes from no group to Wakanda's asylum, so nothing is left there.

Black Widow (Budapest flashback, his first step) has Clint already working as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, so the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage starts there, not at Thor. At the end of Age of Ultron he retires from the Avengers and goes home to his family, a retirement the record does not show. In Civil War Steve calls him out of retirement to fight on his side ('Says he's retired'). After the Raft he officially retires from the Avengers again and takes a house-arrest deal, which the existing Civil War left records.

Carol leaves the Kree and Starforce in Captain Marvel and is in no group afterwards. In the mid-credits scene she only answers Fury's pager at the Avengers Compound, and has no group to leave. The second left and the repeated Independent stage record a departure that doesn't happen.
The Beast who greets Monica in The Marvels (post-credits) is from Binary's reality, which Marvel Database designates Earth-TRN1225, not Earth-199999.
In The Marvels (post-credits), Binary (Maria Rambeau) rescues Monica in another reality, which Marvel Database designates Earth-TRN1225 ('Binary's reality'), not Earth-199999.

now: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
changes.evidence: Dr. Raynor is a former U.S. Army officer who was discharged before the series. In The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (episodes 1 and 2) she works as Bucky's court-mandated therapist, and her Army service, with John Walker as a teammate, is only backstory.

owner_calls.question: T:bob-sentry has a left at Thunderbolts* but ends that same title in New Avengers (A:bob has no left). Should the left stay?
options: Keep the left at Thunderbolts*: it records him turning on the team as Sentry and the Void
Remove the left: he ends Thunderbolts* back on the team, as A:bob shows
Add an Independent stage between The Thunderbolts and New Avengers to match the left
owner_calls.evidence: In Thunderbolts*, Valentina makes Bob her Sentry and he turns on the others, then the Void swallows New York. The team reaches him inside the Void, and he joins the New Avengers. All of this happens in one title, so the order of the left and the last stage is unclear.
